config.atm.section.tooltip: Controls whether the Manor House ATM is visible and available for use.
config.atm-enabled.name: Enable Manor House ATM
config.atm-enabled.tooltip: Shows or hides the Manor House ATM and enables or blocks its transactions; the host controls this in multiplayer, and after changing it you should leave and re-enter the Manor House.
config.debug.section.tooltip: Controls detailed diagnostic logging for startup, saves, ATM access, menus, wallets, transactions, settlement, wallet-mode migration, content, and multiplayer synchronization.
config.debug-enabled.name: Debug mode
config.debug-enabled.tooltip: Writes detailed Simple Bank diagnostics to the SMAPI console when enabled; leave this off during normal play to avoid unnecessary logging and diagnostic measurements.
config.controls.section.tooltip: Configures ATM paging, closing, and controller operation; keyboard amount entry continues to use the number keys, Backspace, and Delete.
config.keyboard-page.name: Keyboard: next page
config.keyboard-page.tooltip: Sets the keyboard key that cycles forward through the ATM pages; the default key is Tab.
config.keyboard-close.name: Keyboard: close ATM
config.keyboard-close.tooltip: Sets the keyboard keys that only close the ATM without opening another menu; the defaults are Escape and E.
config.controller-previous-page.name: Controller: previous page
config.controller-previous-page.tooltip: Sets the controller button that cycles backward through the ATM pages; the default button is the left shoulder button.
config.controller-next-page.name: Controller: next page
config.controller-next-page.tooltip: Sets the controller button that cycles forward through the ATM pages; the default button is the right shoulder button.
config.controller-confirm.name: Controller: select / confirm
config.controller-confirm.tooltip: Sets the controller button that activates the focused control or confirms a pending transaction; the default button is A.
config.controller-back.name: Controller: back / close
config.controller-back.tooltip: Sets the controller button that cancels a confirmation or closes the ATM menu; the default button is B.
config.controller-up.name: Controller: move up
config.controller-up.tooltip: Sets the controller input that moves focus upward through tabs, products, keypad keys, and action buttons.
config.controller-down.name: Controller: move down
config.controller-down.tooltip: Sets the controller input that moves focus downward through tabs, products, keypad keys, and action buttons.
config.controller-left.name: Controller: move left
config.controller-left.tooltip: Sets the controller input that moves focus left through tabs, products, keypad keys, and action buttons.
config.controller-right.name: Controller: move right
config.controller-right.tooltip: Sets the controller input that moves focus right through tabs, products, keypad keys, and action buttons.
config.activity-rate.name: Active savings daily rate (%)
config.activity-rate.tooltip: Type the 0% to 1% daily compound rate for active savings; the value is rounded down to four decimal places, so 0.0001 means 0.0001% per day.
config.term-enabled.name: Enable term slot {{slot}}
config.term-enabled.tooltip: Check this box to offer term-deposit slot {{slot}} at the ATM; disabling it does not change contracts already opened from that slot.
config.term-days.name: Term slot {{slot}} duration (days)
config.term-days.tooltip: Sets term-deposit slot {{slot}} to between 1 and 1,120 in-game days; enabled slots must use unique durations.
config.term-rate.name: Term slot {{slot}} daily rate (%)
config.term-rate.tooltip: Type the 0% to 1% daily compound rate locked into new contracts for term slot {{slot}}; the value is rounded down to four decimal places.
config.loan.section.tooltip: Configures loan durations, daily simple-interest rates, and overdue interest rules.
config.loan-enabled.name: Enable loan slot {{slot}}
config.loan-enabled.tooltip: Check this box to offer loan slot {{slot}} at the ATM; disabling it does not change loans already opened from that slot.
config.loan-days.name: Loan slot {{slot}} duration (days)
config.loan-days.tooltip: Sets loan slot {{slot}} to between 1 and 1,120 in-game days; enabled slots must use unique durations.
config.loan-rate.name: Loan slot {{slot}} daily rate (%)
config.loan-rate.tooltip: Type the 0% to 10% daily simple-interest rate locked into new loans for slot {{slot}}; the value is rounded down to four decimal places.
config.overdue-multiplier.name: Overdue rate multiplier
config.overdue-multiplier.tooltip: Multiplies a loan's locked daily rate after its due date, so the default value of 1.5 makes overdue interest accrue at 150% of that rate.
config.collection.section.tooltip: Configures compulsory repayment terms. Values are copied into each new loan and later changes do not rewrite existing contracts.
config.collection-enabled.name: Enable overdue collection
config.collection-enabled.tooltip: Allows new overdue loans to enter compulsory collection after their grace period; this value is locked when the loan is issued.
config.collection-grace.name: Grace period (days)
config.collection-grace.tooltip: Sets how many complete in-game days follow maturity before compulsory collection starts for new loans.
config.collection-active-setoff.name: Set off active savings
config.collection-active-setoff.tooltip: Allows active savings above the configured reserve to repay a new loan when collection starts.
config.collection-active-reserve.name: Active-savings reserve (g)
config.collection-active-reserve.tooltip: Keeps this much active savings outside automatic setoff for each new loan.
config.collection-wallet-reserve.name: Wallet reserve (g)
config.collection-wallet-reserve.tooltip: Keeps this much wallet gold outside daily sweeps and future-income garnishment for each new loan.
config.collection-garnishment.name: Future-income garnishment (%)
config.collection-garnishment.tooltip: Collects this percentage of positive wallet income while a new loan is in collection; fractional gold is carried forward exactly.
config.collection-interest-cap.name: Overdue-interest cap (%)
config.collection-interest-cap.tooltip: Caps cumulative overdue interest at this percentage of original principal for new loans. Set 0 for no cap.
config.collection-default-days.name: Default status after (days)
config.collection-default-days.tooltip: Marks a still-unpaid loan as defaulted after this many collection days. Debt, collection, and capped interest continue.
config.credit.section.tooltip: Configures the formula that determines the maximum principal a player or shared account may borrow.
config.base-credit.name: Base credit (g)
config.base-credit.tooltip: Enter a nonnegative whole-gold base credit; this amount is included before historical earnings are added.
config.earnings-ratio.name: Historical earnings ratio (%)
config.earnings-ratio.tooltip: Sets what percentage of the account owner's historical total earnings is added to the base credit limit.
config.credit-cap.name: Absolute credit cap (g)
config.credit-cap.tooltip: Enter a nonnegative whole-gold hard credit cap; the final credit limit is rounded down to 1,000g.
